none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of F(x), with every component f_i convex and continuously differentiable; strong convexity is not assumed.

oracle.label: component_gradient
oracle.details: A query (i,x) returns the exact component gradient ∇f_i(x). The index and point are selectable; replies have no oracle error, regardless of history or seed.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: The same oracle call also returns the exact component value f_i(x).

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: For each component, whenever ‖∇f_i(x+θ(y−x))‖ ≤ M for all θ∈[0,1], one has ‖∇f_i(x)−∇f_i(y)‖ ≤ (L0+L1 M)‖x−y‖. Here L0>0 and L1≥0; no global Lipschitz gradient bound is required.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is an arbitrary real Hilbert space with a measurable-space structure. A minimizer x* satisfies ‖x0−x*‖≤R, F(x0)−F(x*)≤Δ, and (1/n)Σ_i ‖∇f_i(x*)‖≤G. This bounds average component gradient norms, not their squares, and permits nonzero component gradients at x*. All parameters, including n,L0,L1,G,R,Δ,ε,x0, are public; component functions and the minimizer are hidden. R,Δ,ε>0 and G≥0.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothFiniteSum.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, and spec.admissible.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable E-valued output X with integrable objective gap and E[F(X)−F(x*)]≤ε for a global minimizer x*.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: The guarantee is in expectation over algorithm and oracle seeds. Execution uses a fixed upper budget of component value-and-gradient calls, rather than an expected stopping cost.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothFiniteSum.lean: spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence and executeWithTrace; supplied result budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The finite-sum convex formulation uses componentwise gradient-dependent smoothness and an average component-gradient norm bound at a minimizer, rather than standard global smoothness or a common-minimizer assumption.
